messages:
Maya (Support): Customer Acme Ltd escalated — their invoice PDF is missing the VAT number and the registered company address. They asked that VAT # be visible near the header, billing address split into company / reg. address lines, and each line item show tax applied (they need it for EU reclaim). Ticket RA-4127 includes the sample PDF. Any quick remediation?

Ava (Billing): Can you drop the invoice_id and account? I can fetch the exact PDF we generated. We recently introduced a compact template for small accounts — might be falling back.

Maya (Support): invoice_id: inv_2026_00123, account: acme-ltd. Uploaded sample PDF to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RA-4127 (attachment). Repro steps I used: POST /v1/invoices with body {"customer":"acme-ltd","items":[{"desc":"API credits","qty":1,"unit_price":120.00,"tax_rate":0.20}],"customer_vat":"GB999999973"} — PDF rendered without the customer_vat and company_registered_name fields.

Ravi (Eng): Repro locally with your payload. Quick find: template expects customer.vat_number and billing_profile.registered_name, but API populates customer.vat and customer.registered_company in some older accounts. We have a mismatch.

Ravi (Eng): Patch suggestion (will open PR): align template to accept both fields and prefer explicit billing_profile override. Example Jinja snippet I'm going to add to the invoice template:
```jinja
{% if customer.vat_number or customer.vat %}
  VAT # {{ customer.vat_number or customer.vat }}
{% endif %}

{% if billing_profile.registered_name_override or customer.registered_company %}
  Legal entity: {{ billing_profile.registered_name_override or customer.registered_company }}
{% endif %}
```
Also adding per-line tax column. Example invoice JSON we render from service: 
```json
{
  "id": "inv_2026_00123",
  "customer": {"id":"acme-ltd","vat":"GB999999973","registered_company":"Acme Limited"},
  "items": [{"desc":"API credits","qty":1,"unit_price":120.00,"tax_rate":0.20}]
}
```

Liam (Finance): Confirming requirements: for EU/UK customers we must display VAT number on the PDF and a VAT breakdown per line (tax base, tax rate, tax amount). For PO customers include PO Number prominently under invoice header. For enterprise contracts include: Registered name, Registered address (street, city, postcode, country) and TAX_ID (for non-VAT tax identifiers). Also keep one-line summary and then a detailed table for accounting teams.

Noah (Legal): Legal: registered name must match the name on the signed contract or the sales-provided override. Please add a validation note in the billing profile UI: "Registered name (legal) — used for invoices" and map to billing_profile.registered_name_override. This avoids auto-surfacing informal DBA names.

Maya (Support): Customer is on an annual renewal tomorrow — can we do a hotfix? They said if PDF is corrected they'll sign the amendment.

Ravi (Eng): I can push the template change to staging in ~20m and add unit tests for both field variants and the per-line tax columns. Also update the PDF renderer to include an optional PO row when invoice.meta.po_number exists. Deploy plan: staging -> smoke -> prod hotfix. ETA ~1.5h including QA.

Ava (Billing): Once Ravi has staging build, I can generate a fresh PDF for inv_2026_00123 and attach to the support ticket for customer confirmation. If customer provides a PO, make sure "PO Number" ends up in invoice.meta.po_number so it surfaces in the header.

deploy-bot: deployment started: invoice-template-hotfix -> staging (ravi/PR-4821) :rocket:

Maya (Support): Thanks everyone — I'll keep Acme updated. Will paste their signed PO here if we get it. :thumbsup:
